claims.statement: uvicorn loads app.main:app, which is create_configured_app: dotenv once, GatewaySettings, build_runtime, then create_app.
Only LiteLLMRouterRuntime may construct litellm.Router or assign litellm.cache; architecture tests fail any other module that does so.
The application package is forbidden from importing FastAPI, LiteLLM, Mem0, Presidio, Redis, API routes, or infrastructure modules.
FastAPI lifespan starts GatewayRuntime then closes it, draining memory work before shutting budget and Router.
